features.heading: Your command center for game news
features.sub: One idea drives it all: get the real story, fast, without the clickbait.

items.title: Multi-platform channels
items.text: Jump straight to Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox, PC or Reviews — or stream everything in one unified feed.

items.title: Key-point summaries
items.text: Every release leads with a bullet-point briefing, so you grasp the story in seconds before diving deeper.

items.title: Verified sources
items.text: Each story links back to its original outlets — read with confidence and follow the trail yourself.

items.title: Bookmarks & profiles
items.text: Save stories for later and build a profile around the topics and platforms you care about most.

items.title: Create & publish
items.text: Authors draft and publish releases through a dedicated creation flow, with tasks to manage the pipeline.

items.title: Trending & topics
items.text: Discover what the community is reading with Trending News and topics like Esports and Indie Games.

gettingStarted.heading: From headline to the full story in three steps

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Open a clean, sortable feed and filter by your platform. Trending and recommended topics surface what matters now.

steps.title: Read smart
steps.text: Lead with the key points, then read the full release — every claim backed by linked original sources.

steps.title: Save & share
steps.text: Bookmark stories, manage them from your profile, and — as an author — create and publish your own releases.

audience.heading: Built for gamers who want signal, not noise
audience.text: Gaming news moves fast and spreads thin across dozens of sites. NRS pulls it together, trims it down, and keeps it honest — so you spend less time hunting and more time playing.
points: Console & PC players tracking releases, prices and updates
